public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI will need to raise funding at least three more times in the next decade.

statement.excerpt: Based on my own reporting on its audited financials from 2024 and 2025, OpenAI will need to raise funding at least three more times in the next decade.

from_speaker: OpenAI will need to raise funding
our_interpretation: The decade runs from publication through July 15, 2036.
Count distinct new financings after publication. Payments under an already agreed round and secondary sales that do not fund OpenAI are not additional rounds.
Need means financing required to meet operating or contractual obligations. Raising money alone does not establish necessity.
The cited financial basis is company-reported accounts. The word audited does not establish a particular accounting standard.
criteria.support_condition: At least three distinct additional financings occur within the horizon, with financial records establishing that they were necessary.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Complete records through the deadline establish fewer than three necessary additional financings.
